parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA

figures.quote: Adjusted EBITDA was $123.2 million for the quarter, up $13.7 million, or up 12.5%, from the same period in 2025, driven by both acquisition contribution and organic growth .

parsed.notes: The excerpt cuts off before the Adjusted EBITDA row of the reconciliation table (in thousands), so the Q2 2026 figure comes from the narrative text. The Q2 2025 figure is not printed. It would be about $109.5 million, implied by the stated $13.7 million increase, but it is not reported here. The six-month year-to-date Adjusted EBITDA figures are not shown in the excerpt. FY2026 guidance of $473–$483 million is a forecast and is not included.
